title: Users & permissions
summary: Credentials, access checks, set-ID execution, accounts, su and sudo-style administration, the standard filesystem layout and non-root logins on the console and over SSH behave as POSIX and the users design specify.

A thread whose process cannot be found is refused, never checked as root (forcing point)
